title: 20210506-sentencing-process-report-on-public-consultation-exercise-final.pdf — section 5
text:
5. The purpose of this report is to set out the Council’s views on some of the most
common matters raised during the public consultation exercise and to give an
indication of how the guideline submitted to the High Court will differ as a result.
Should the guideline be approved by the High Court (either as submitted or with
modifications), it will be published by the Council shortly afterwards.

6. We have deliberately focused on addressing those matters which appear to be of
most interest to respondents. While not all points raised are covered in this report,
all of the responses received have been considered.

7. Part 1 of this report sets out the Council’s views on the public consu ltation
exercise, including the actions which will be taken as a result.

8. Part 2 explains the likely next steps in relation to the guideline.
